name: multilingual-unsafe-tools-activation-bench
description: A multilingual safety benchmark that measures whether models will activate or describe unsafe tool usage across multiple languages and prompts. It evaluates model propensity to follow or enable harmful tool-based instructions when presented in different linguistic contexts.
evaluation_method: accuracy / F1 (classification of unsafe activation) and manual/human inspection for open-ended outputs
reputation: A niche, community-contributed dataset on Hugging Face with limited adoption outside safety research and hobbyist evaluations.
